title: Expedition 68 Uncrewed Soyuz MS-23 Launch to International Space Station - Feb. 23, 2023
description: An uncrewed Soyuz MS-23 spacecraft launched atop a Soyuz 2.1a rocket from the Baikonur Cosmodrome in Kazakhstan on Feb. 23, 2023. Following a two-day rendezvous, the vehicle will dock to the Poisk module of the International Space Station to replace the Soyuz MS-22 spacecraft Roscosmos cosmonauts Sergey Prokopyev and Dmitri Petelin and NASA astronaut Frank Rubio launched on last September that incurred a coolant loop leak in December.   Join NASA as we go forward to the Moon and on to Mars -- discover the latest on Earth, the Solar System and beyond with a weekly update in your inbox.  Subscribe at: www.nasa.gov/subscribe
